So anyway, I keep my word about the reward, check out the new rifles I have...}} ==Guide== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !'''[[Found in raid|Find in raid]]''' !Notes |- ![[File:30x160mmShellicon.png|link=OFZ 30x165mm shell]] |[[OFZ 30x165mm shell]] |3 |Handover item !Yes |Can be crafted in the [[Hideout]] (Workbench lv. 3). |- ![[File:Mil Batt icon.png|link=6-STEN-140-M military battery]] |[[6-STEN-140-M military battery]] |1 |Handover item !Yes | |} The items required for this quest need to be [[found in raid]]. They can be found as Loose Loot on [[Lighthouse]] and [[Reserve]], but can be found in containers elsewhere, as well as a small chance for a Scav to have it in their backpack. The [[6-STEN-140-M military battery]] is a large 4x2 slot item that resembles a black/brown box. It can most commonly be found sitting on or near tanks. The [[OFZ 30x165mm shell]]s can be found throughout the [[Reserve]] on tables, shelving and at the rear side of every tank on the map, on the ground. Both of the items required for this quest can also be obtained from the [[Hideout#Scav Case|Scav Case]] in the [[Hideout]].
